citations.quote: ECOG 2 indicates the patient is ambulatory but limited in daily activities

candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients, reflecting their ability to perform activities of daily living.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify and extract the numeric value associated with 'ECOG' or 'ECOG performance status'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status scale, where 0 represents fully active and 4 represents completely disabled.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: Only a value of 2 is documented across the provided snippets; the full range of the scale is not represented.

candidates.description: The percentage of tumor cells expressing Programmed Death-Ligand 1, used as a biomarker for immunotherapy eligibility.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical percentage value following the term 'PD-L1 expression'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Percentage (%) of tumor cells showing positivity for PD-L1 via immunohistochemistry (IHC).
candidates.name: PD-L1 Expression
candidates.uncertainty: The specific IHC assay or scoring system (e.g., TPS) used to derive the percentage is not specified.

limitations: The evidence is based on a very small number of patient records.
Quantitative biomarker data (PD-L1, TMB) are only provided for a subset of the patients described.
summary: The provided evidence identifies several baseline clinical variables associated with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including functional status (ECOG), biomarker expression (PD-L1), and primary tumor dimensions.
